welcome.title: Hi! 👋 I'm your guide
welcome.body: I'll walk you step by step through MarketMate setup. You can skip anytime (top right) and resume later from Settings.

logistica.title: Your logistics 🚚
logistica.body: Where do you start each day and what vehicle do you use? Used to calculate km and fuel cost.

settings_intro.title: Now let's set up the engine ⚙️
settings_intro.body: This is the longest part, but you only do it once. I'll guide you through collaborators, markets, suppliers and fixed expenses. After that, just open HOME each day: the app does the rest. Ready? 🚀

collab_setup.title: Collaborators first 👥
collab_setup.body: Have helpers? Add their names now (e.g. Sara, Paolo). Wages and other details can be added later, when you have more time.

agenda_setup.title: Now your markets 📅
agenda_setup.body: For each weekday add the market (name, city, km). The PITCH FEE goes here, inside each market card (daily or annual). You can also do this part later.

fornitori_setup.title: Add suppliers 🚛
fornitori_setup.body: Enter your regular suppliers (e.g. Bread Andrea, Dairy Rossi). Everything saves as you type. If you don't have them handy, add them later.

spese_fisse_setup.title: Fixed expenses 💸
spese_fisse_setup.body: Add annual expenses: van insurance, social security, accountant, taxes, etc. The app will spread them across working days automatically. Try adding 1-2 entries.

home_calendar.title: Welcome to HOME! 🏠
home_calendar.body: This is your daily working screen. At the top you see the date: use ◀ ▶ arrows to change day, or tap the date for the full calendar.

home_lordo.title: Today's weather ☀️
home_lordo.body: The app preselects the weather based on forecasts. You can always change it manually by tapping the matching icon (sun, cloud, rain...).

home_incasso.title: How much did you earn today? 💰
home_incasso.body: Enter the GROSS total, then enter ONLY ONE between: CASH amount or CARD amount. The app calculates the rest automatically.

spese_extra_voci.title: Today's expenses 🛒
spese_extra_voci.body: Tap EXPENSES to add every cost of today: from suppliers (you'll see the names you saved) to any free entry. Examples: coffee €3, breakfast €5, lunch €12, parking €4, tolls €8.

buongiorno.title: The «Good Morning» AI 🤖
buongiorno.body: Every morning open Good Morning to get the REAL WEATHER and the GAS STATION with the BEST PRICE along your route. Plus: deadlines, top markets and personalized tips based on YOUR data.

home_stats_box.title: Stats panel 📊
home_stats_box.body: At the bottom of Home you see 4 live numbers: GROSS, NET, PROFIT and COSTS. Tap PROFIT for details: same-market revenue (e.g. every Saturday) over the month, year, and comparison with previous year. A must-have at-a-glance for market vendors.

home_salva.title: Save the day 💾
home_salva.body: When ready, tap SAVE to archive the day. You'll find it in history, charts and statistics. ✏️ You can always go back with the calendar and edit a saved day's data.

stats.title: Your statistics 📊
stats.body: Here you see gross/net charts, top markets, top suppliers, pie charts and many other insights. Explore: each time filter (month/year/custom) shows different data.

carburante_setup.title: Fuel consumption ⛽
carburante_setup.body: Enter NOW a refuel example: liters and euros. The app will use this to automatically calculate how much each market costs based on km driven.

notes_setup.title: The NOTES page 📝
notes_setup.body: Here you write appointments, orders to suppliers, deadlines, ideas. Add NOW an appointment (e.g. 'Accountant Tuesday 10:00'). You'll find it in the Home calendar and in the 🔔 notifications bell.

backup_info.title: Data backup 💾
backup_info.body: Important: always export a backup! Go to Settings → DATA BACKUP and tap EXPORT to save a file. Send it via WhatsApp, email or load it later if you change phone.

done.title: 🎉 All set!
done.body: You're ready to start! Remember: you can relaunch this guide anytime from Settings → RESTART GUIDE. Good luck!
